P_calibration.quote: Multiple vessels each recovering no more than 10,000 metric tons annually could fall outside subparagraph (A), though subparagraph (B) may apply.

P_reliance_caveat.quote: These are potential arguments, not assured lawful operating paths: other permitting requirements and environmental laws would remain applicable, and § 2(1)(B)'s risk-based provision could reach activities outside the numerical thresholds.
